## Applying these values

The repository metadata is separate from version-controlled files. An administrator can update both from the repository's **About** sidebar (gear icon): paste the description, remove deprecated technology topics and replace the topic list with the 20 entries above, then save. The authenticated GitHub integration used for this branch exposes repository file and pull-request modifications but not the administration-write action for description and topics. Do not report the metadata as changed until its live repository API response confirms the new values.

## Verification boundary

The maintained code and documents use Python/Dask/Deal and Rocq. The previous alternative implementation was removed from the current Git tree; historical commits remain available, but do not certify the current Python implementation. The six-book PDFs must correspond to the six current TeX sources and CI tests must pass on the merged commit.

**Complete AI disclosure:** OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex and other AI assistants contributed to the repository migration, profile wording, methodological explanations and verification checks. Automated CI tests and Rocq formal proof checking have limited, source-specific scope. No independent human peer review or empirical calibration is represented by this repository metadata.
